title: Minimal height expression
description: Essential: The final answer for part (a) is correctly expressed as h = (B²/A²) * (1/(2g)) * (T_air / ΔT).

title: Warm-region chimney height
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (b) is 145 m, derived from the correct ratio of temperatures.

title: Velocity and pressure profiles
description: Important: Correctly applies Bernoulli's equation and hydrostatic balance to derive expressions for velocity (constant) and linear pressure variation with height.

title: Efficiency derivation
description: Important: Derives the plant efficiency η = gh/(c T_atm) from the ratio of kinetic power output to solar heating power input.

title: Power and energy calculation
description: Important: Correctly calculates prototype power (45 kW) and daily energy output (360 kWh) using given parameters and the efficiency.

title: Mass flow rate determination
description: Important: Correctly calculates the mass flow rate (760 kg/s) using either the continuity/velocity relation or the solar heating balance.

title: Density-temperature relation
description: Optional: Uses the ideal gas law to relate density ratio to temperature ratio (ρ_air/ρ_smoke = T_smoke/T_air) in derivations.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent SI units and converts temperatures to Kelvin where necessary.

title: Sign error in pressure
description: Pitfall: Incorrect sign in the hydrostatic pressure term or the buoyancy-driven pressure difference in the chimney.

title: Temperature unit mistake
description: Pitfall: Uses Celsius values directly in the ideal gas law or efficiency formula instead of converting to Kelvin.
